## About
AJ's Tire Center is a family-owned tire shop on E Okeechobee Rd in Hialeah. We handle new and used tires for cars, trucks and SUVs, plus mounting, balancing, rotation, alignment, flat repair, TPMS and front-end suspension work.
We give you a clear quote before we touch your car, and you approve every charge. Our team speaks English and Spanish, so you can ask questions in whichever language is easier for you.
Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating across 249 Google reviews. One reviewer sent his dad over before a road trip north, and the crew made sure he left with new tires, balanced and safe for the road.

## Services
- New and used tires: All sizes and brands for cars, trucks and SUVs, with quality used tires when you need to save.
- Mounting and balancing: Careful mounting and balancing for a smooth ride without vibration.
- Tire rotation and wheel alignment: Rotations and alignments that help your tread last longer and wear evenly.
- Flat and puncture repair: Patch-plug repairs done to industry safety standards.
- TPMS service: Sensor diagnosis, reset and replacement for your tire-pressure warning light.
- Front-end suspension: We diagnose front-end problems and repair them for a smoother, safer ride.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Appointments are preferred, but walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead usually means little to no wait.

Q: What brands do you carry?
A: All the major brands, including Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone, Pirelli, Continental, BFGoodrich, Falken and Cooper.

Q: Are your used tires safe?
A: Every used tire is checked by hand for tread depth, age and damage before we sell it.

Q: How long does it take?
A: Most tire installs and repairs are done in under 45 minutes, and we'll give you an honest time estimate when you arrive.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash, major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Zelle.
